name: fmp_historical_dcf
description:
Historical DCF valuations for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/historical-discounted-cash-flow): DCF value per share and stock price per period.
Returns {symbol, historical_dcf}: FMP's list of period records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), period (annual or quarter; default annual), limit (integer, number of periods; default 5).
For the current value use fmp_dcf_valuation.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "annual", "limit": 5}
